mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point rise in unemployment rate over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a housing sector collapse that triggers broader economic weakness and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) decline below 950.0 thousand units over three months indicates severe housing market weakness that reduces consumer spending and triggers negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST falls below 950.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate accelerating labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5% signals accelerating inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that signals economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
